_comment: Persistent state for the cleanup-loop. The orchestrator reads this at the start of every iteration and writes it at the end, so the loop survives context compaction and session restarts. Populated by the initial scan (11 parallel scanners, 2026-06-15). pending[] is ordered by priority: score desc, then deletable LOC desc, with lower-risk server modules (have a vitest net) ahead of client modules (build-gate only).
guidingPrinciple: The best code is the one that was never written. Prefer DELETE > SIMPLIFY > REWRITE.

knownBugs_notForSimplifier._comment: Behavior-CHANGING fixes surfaced by the scan. The Simplifier's contract is behavior-PRESERVING, so it must NOT silently 'clean' these. Parked here so they aren't lost; fix them deliberately (with a test) outside the cleanup loop, or move into manual_review.
